label: M (BLIND: long, crowded histories; written after the step 1 and 2 fixes, before any run; run once)
description: SET M: long histories. Three users with 90 or more messages each over about 18 months: moves, job changes, a partner change, other people with their own cities and jobs, several similar trips, plans that change, and many everyday questions, some on the same topics as the user's life. 57 questions: current facts, past values, episodes and details, indirect questions, third-person traps and abstain questions. Status: BLIND. Predictions: docs/predictions/set_M.md. All people, places and companies are new.
